title: Maintenance Lead

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Anduril Australia is seeking an experienced and skilled Maintenance Manager to oversee the maintenance operations for our Maritime products (including Robot Submarines!) and associated equipment, on behalf of our Customers. The ideal candidate will be responsible for executing and managing maintenance to ensure optimal performance, reliability, and availability of our Maritime Assets. This position requires a highly organized and detail-oriented individual who can work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic and high-pressure environment. The successful candidate must be able to balance multiple priorities, adapt to changing requirements, and maintain a strong focus on safety and operational excellence in the Naval defence industry.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Recruit and manage a team of skilled technicians and tradespeople to maintain XL autonomous underwater vehicles.

• Establish forward operating facilities and infrastructure for the conduct of test and maintenance activities.

• Develop and implement comprehensive maintenance plans and schedules.

• Guide the development of maintenance documentation, including manuals, standard practices and parts catalogues (in a Tech. environment).

• Ensure compliance with safety regulations, environmental standards, and quality control procedures.

• Oversee preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance activities.

• Collaborate with the Fleet Engineering team to improve equipment reliability and maintainability.

• Analyze maintenance data and key metrics to identify trends and areas for improvement.

• Develop and manage maintenance budgets, including forecasting and cost control.

• Coordinate with supply chain management to ensure availability of spare parts and materials.

• Liaise with Maritime customers, regulatory bodies, and external stakeholders as required.

• Provide stakeholder input into root cause analysis for equipment failures and implement corrective actions.

• Work closely with the Product Lifecycle Maintenance function to optimise the total lifecycle cost.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Suitable trade or engineering qualification.

• 7-10+ years of experience in maintenance management, in a high-tech industry.

• Proven experience in influencing and engaging customers.

• Proven experience in developing and implementing maintenance strategies and facilities.

• Experience with condition-based maintenance and predictive maintenance technologies.

• Strong leadership and team management skills.

• Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

• Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to obtain and maintain a NV2 Security Clearance.

title: recruiter
description:
People Attraction Partner
Full-Cycle Recruiting • Talent Partnership • Candidate Experience

The People Attraction Partner manages the full recruitment lifecycle and helps attract the talent needed to support organizational growth. This role partners with hiring leaders to understand staffing needs, develop recruiting strategies, identify and assess qualified candidates, and deliver a positive experience from initial contact through offer acceptance and onboarding handoff.
What You’ll Be Doing
You will support a variety of positions and may manage high-volume, field-based, corporate, and specialized hiring needs. Success requires the ability to move quickly, manage competing priorities, build trusted relationships, and provide useful talent-market guidance.
● Manage full-cycle recruiting: Lead recruiting from intake through offer acceptance, including sourcing, screening, interview coordination, candidate evaluation, offer preparation, and onboarding handoff.
● Partner with hiring leaders: Clarify position requirements, ideal candidate profiles, hiring timelines, and business priorities while providing consistent updates and recommendations.
● Build candidate pipelines: Use job boards, social media, referrals, networking, direct outreach, recruiting events, and other sourcing channels to develop qualified talent pools.
● Assess and present talent: Evaluate candidates for experience, capabilities, motivation, compensation expectations, and overall alignment, then present qualified candidates with clear recommendations.
● Deliver a strong candidate experience: Maintain timely, professional communication so candidates understand the opportunity, expectations, interview process, and next steps.
● Support offers and hiring decisions: Partner with hiring leaders and People Operations to develop competitive offers, extend verbal offers, support negotiations, and drive offer acceptance.
● Provide talent-market insights: Share information about candidate availability, compensation expectations, hiring challenges, market conditions, and competitor activity.
● Maintain recruiting data and compliance: Keep candidate records, interview activity, hiring status, and recruiting metrics accurate within the applicant tracking system while following company policy and applicable employment requirements.
What We’re Looking For
We are seeking a proactive, results-oriented recruiter who enjoys connecting people with opportunities and building strong partnerships with hiring leaders. The ideal candidate is organized, resourceful, comfortable in a fast-paced environment, and able to manage multiple searches while maintaining excellent communication and follow-through.
You’ll Need to Have

• Two or more years of full-cycle recruiting or talent acquisition experience.

• Experience sourcing, screening, interviewing, and presenting qualified candidates.

• Experience partnering directly with hiring managers throughout the selection process.

• Strong written and verbal communication, organization, and time-management skills.

• Ability to manage multiple openings and shifting priorities simultaneously.

• Experience working with an applicant tracking system and recruiting platforms.

• Sound judgment and the ability to handle sensitive and confidential information appropriately.

Even Better If You Have

• A bachelor’s degree in human resources, business, communications, or a related field.

• Experience supporting high-volume, field-based, retail, sales, technical, or corporate hiring.

• Experience recruiting across multiple locations or markets.

• Experience developing proactive sourcing strategies and long-term talent pipelines.

• Knowledge of employment practices and recruiting compliance.

• Experience using recruiting data and market insights to influence hiring decisions.

• Experience supporting new program launches or rapid organizational growth.

• Experience working with staffing agencies, outsourcing partners, or other external talent pro

title: Full-Stack AI Engineer
description:
Join Hire Hangar and work with fast-growing global companies while building a long-term career.

Job Title Full-Stack AI Engineer

Location Remote

Time Zone US Time Zones (EST-PST)

Role Overview
We are seeking a senior Full-Stack AI Engineer to join our platform team and own the end-to-end build of a data ingestion and intelligence layer for enterprise customers in the media vertical. This is a high-impact, high-ownership role at the intersection of AI, data engineering, and product. You will architect and ship pipelines that transform unstructured creative assets and ad performance data into a semantic, vector-based layer - and expose it through AI agents and a polished React frontend. We move fast, ship to production, and hold a high bar for craft and reliability.

What You'll Build

- A dual-mode data ingestion engine handling creative components (CTAs, headers, body copy, images, video, and metadata) and ad performance data (channel-level signals tied to those components)

- Multi-modal embedding generation and storage - vector plus structured - optimised for retrieval quality and cost

- AI agent tooling that enables natural language search, comparison, and reasoning across the creative and performance data layer

- A React frontend that lets users explore the creative library, query performance data in plain English, and surface actionable optimisation insights

- Audit-logged decisioning and governance infrastructure to meet enterprise-grade requirements

Key Responsibilities

- Design and build durable, idempotent ingestion pipelines for creative and performance data at scale (queues, retries, backpressure, dedup, schema evolution)

- Generate and manage embeddings for multi-modal creative assets; select and operate the right vector store for the workload

- Build and maintain retrieval pipelines that serve AI agent tools with accurate, low-latency responses

- Ship agent-style systems with tool use, state management, and multi-step reasoning workflows

- Develop and maintain the React frontend for the creative intelligence library and query interface

- Own the full lifecycle of your systems: design, build, deploy, monitor, and iterate

- Contribute to stack decisions with clear reasoning grounded in production experience

- Collaborate closely with product and enterprise partners to translate requirements into reliable, scalable systems

Required Qualifications

- Strong TypeScript - you use types as a design tool, not a formality

- Production experience with serverless or edge runtimes (Cloudflare Workers, Vercel, Lambda, Deno Deploy, or equivalent)

- Demonstrated experience building durable, idempotent ingestion pipelines with queuing, retry logic, backpressure handling, deduplication, and schema evolution

- Practical, production-level understanding of embeddings, chunking strategies, and retrieval quality tuning

- At least one agent-style system shipped to production: tool use, stateful multi-step workflows - framework matters less than the experience

- React fluency with modern patterns and component architecture

- Comfort operating across two cloud environments; able to reason clearly about when to use edge compute vs. managed data/AI services, and how to bridge them

- Must have prior remote work experience, be fluent with remote collaboration tools and platforms (such as Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace, Linear, or similar), and have ideally worked with US or UK-based companies. Applications without this experience will not be considered.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building or operating RAG systems in production

- Familiarity with current embedding models and the tradeoffs across dimension, quality, and cost

- Background in ETL design, observability for data pipelines, or evaluation frameworks for retrieval quality

- Adtech, performance marketing, or marketing analytics background - understanding what channels, attribution, and creative testing look like in a live production context

We are seeking an experienced PTC Solutions Developer to design, develop, and support customizations, integrations, and enhancements on the Windchill PLM platform. In this role you will work closely with PLM functional consultants and engineering stakeholders to translate manufacturing and product-lifecycle requirements into well-engineered Windchill solutions. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners - product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders - to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

• Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation - including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures - so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.

• Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time.

title: Tier 2 Cybersecurity Operations Analyst
description:
Join the team leading the next evolution of virtual care.
At Teladoc Health , you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives.
Here you will be part of a high-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens.
Job Description

Summary of Position

The Tier 2 Cyber Security Operations Analyst is responsible for performing advanced analysis of security incidents, conducting in-depth investigations, and implementing mitigation strategies to protect organizational IT infrastructure. This role serves as an escalation point for Tier 1 analysts, requiring strong technical expertise, analytical skills, and the ability to handle complex cyber threats in a fast-paced SOC environment.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Incident Analysis and Response:

• Investigate escalated security incidents from Tier 1, including malware infections, advanced persistent threats (APTs), phishing campaigns, and unauthorized access attempts.

• Perform root cause analysis to identify the source, scope, and impact of incidents.

• Implement containment, eradication, and recovery measures, such as isolating compromised systems or applying security patches.

2. Threat Hunting and Proactive Monitoring:

• Conduct proactive threat hunting using SIEM tools and endpoint detection and response (EDR/XDR) platforms.

• Analyze Indicators of Compromise (IoCs) and Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs) to identify potential threats.

• Correlate logs and alerts to detect patterns of malicious activity.

3. Security Tool Optimization:

• Configure and fine-tune security tools, including SIEM and SOAR platform.

• Develop and update SIEM rules, dashboards, and alerts to improve detection accuracy.

4. Documentation and Reporting:

• Document incident details, including timelines, findings, and remediation steps, in ticketing systems.

• Prepare detailed incident reports and post-incident reviews for management and compliance purposes.

• Contribute to the development of standard operating procedures (SOPs) and playbooks for incident response.

5. Collaboration and Escalation:

• Work closely with Tier 1 analysts to mentor and guide them on alert triage and basic incident handling.

• Collaborate with Senior Analysts, threat intelligence teams, and IT departments for advanced investigations and remediation.

• Liaise with external stakeholders, such as CERT-In or third-party vendors, during major incidents.

6. Threat Intelligence Integration:

• Incorporate threat intelligence feeds into security monitoring processes.

• Stay updated on emerging cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and attack trends relevant to the organization’s industry.

Skills and Qualifications:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field. Relevant certifications or equivalent experience may substitute.

• Experience: 4-7 years of experience in cybersecurity, preferably in a SOC environment or as a Tier 1 analyst. Hands-on experience with incident response is essential.

•
Technical Skills:

• Advanced knowledge of networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN) and operating systems (Windows, Linux, macOS).

• Proficiency with SIEM platforms, EDR/XDR tools, and network security appliances.

• Experience with log analysis, packet capture tools (e.g., Wireshark), and scripting (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash) for automation.

• Familiarity with cloud security (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and related tools is a plus.

• Understanding of attack frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and common vulnerabilities (e.g., CVE database).

•
Certifications (preferred):

• CompTIA Security+, CISSP

• Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)

• GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH)

title: Senior People Partner
description:
Senior People Partner

📍 Manchester, UK (Hybrid 4 days WFH) | 💰 £60,000 - £70,000

Street Group is a fast moving B2B SaaS business - grown in Manchester but on a UK wide mission to make moving house as easy as buying a car. We’ve recently raised Series B funding, and are scaling fast toward an ambitious growth plan - and we’re looking for a Senior People Partner to ensure we get there.

Over the past 6 years, our People team has designed, built, and implemented the people processes that have scaled Street Group from 30 - 230 people. But we know that systems that work at 150 people can break at 300 - and we want to get ahead of that.

This is an opportunity for someone who has been through that scaling journey before to have an oversized impact on a small but ambitious People team to become best in class.

If you know what can impact culture both positively and negatively as a company grows; have experience building systems that both set people up to do their best work AND that scale alongside the business; and embrace AI and the positive impact it can have on employee experience - we think you might do great work here.

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS NOW

Our People team is lean - and as we mature as a business, there’s limited capacity to ensure we’re constantly innovating and improving the mechanisms that enable people to do their best work. We have ambitious goals to achieve - now is the time to fine-tune our People function to ensure the business hits those goals.

THE ROLE

In 2026, over half of the business told us they don't know what excellence looks like in their role, or how excellence is rewarded. This is the crux of this role; to build the systems, processes and reward that sets people up for success and ensure we reward and retain our best people.

Over the next 12-18 months, this will mean you'll be working with our Head of People and People Partner on initiatives that clarify excellence and reward - our internal levels framework, compensation & reward, embedding our excellence standard throughout the business, and coaching managers on a team by team basis to increase overall performance.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- An experienced People Partner passionate about their craft; curious about how technology and innovation is changing the People landscape, and constantly looking for more impactful ways to support the business.

- A commercial mindset - e.g. you measure your results on impact on business and team performance rather than work shipped.

- An AI-native mindset: you treat AI as leverage and are keen to learn from our team, and share what’s been working for you - but understand the nuances of where AI can never replace genuine People Partnering.

- The credibility and communication skills to bring busy managers on the journey with you.

- Someone who makes the team better on purpose, not by accident: you share what you know and help develop the people around you.

WHY YOU MIGHT NOT WANT TO APPLY

We'd rather be honest up front, because this role won’t be for everyone.

- If you want to move into people management. This is a senior IC role. You'll coach, share knowledge, and set standards, but you won't have direct reports. If a management title is what you're chasing now or in the imminent future, this isn’t the job for you.

- If you haven't been through a similar scaling journey in SaaS businesses before. Our People team is home grown; we're specifically looking for the experience and knowledge that comes from having been there/done that before, and can prevent us from making common mistakes.

- If AI feels like a threat rather than a tool. We love Claude Cowork, and have both built and used multiple other tools to improve and speed up our ways of working. We have a company-wide expectation that AI is utilised, so it will be a large part of this role.

Wir sind Klickkonzept. Eine datengetriebene, KI-orientierte Online-Marketing-Agentur im Herzen von Frankfurt. Paid Search (SEA) - bezahlte Sichtbarkeit in Google & Co.
Paid Social - Performance-Kampagnen auf Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn & Co.

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity.

- Turn complex product developments into clear, accurate stories for people who buy, build with, or assess our products.

- Build relationships with reporters and other voices who shape enterprise technology decisions, developing stories that extend beyond launch-day coverage.

- Drive launch execution from early messaging and customer proof through spokesperson preparation, media outreach, and learning from the response.

- Advise senior partners on the business story, clarify ownership and expert review early, and help teams make sound decisions quickly when priorities change.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

- Deep experience communicating complex enterprise technology in terms of business needs and outcomes.

- A record of leading significant launches and building a durable market narrative between them.

- Excellent writing, with a habit of explaining technical capabilities without jargon.

- Strong judgment about what enterprise buyers need to know, what customer evidence supports, and where future ambition begins.

- The confidence to work closely with senior executives and bring teams to a decision under pressure.

- The ability to move from strategy into hands-on execution at speed, and curiosity about new ways to reach business audiences.

title: Remote Device Clinician - Contractor
description:
A Rhythm Remote Device Clinician remotely monitors patients with cardiac implantable electronic devices (CIEDs) utilizing Rhythm ’s proprietary software. This specialist employs knowledge of cardiac electrophysiology and biomedical engineering concepts to assess the technical function of the patient’s CIED, analyze and interpret device and patient diagnostics, and perform accurate clinical documentation as determined by Rhythm ’s best practice standards.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Integrate a knowledge base from physiology, pathophysiology, and cardiac device function to perform competent evaluations, diagnostic reviews, and overall analysis through remote monitoring.

• Recognize abnormal functions of pacemakers, defibrillators, ILRs, and CRT devices, and recommend strategies to address and correct issues.

• Communicate with Rhythm ’s clinical team and providers regarding CIED function and diagnostic data through accurate, professional, and standardized documentation.

• Maintain confidentiality of sensitive information and adhere to all Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) and Protected Health Information (PHI) standards/protocols.

• Support and contribute to Rhythm ’s patient-centered care philosophy: Every team member is a caregiver whose role is to meet the needs of the patient.

Requirements

• Bachelor's or associate degree required OR experience in a related field-nursing, medicine, electronics, or engineering.

• Successful completion of a cardiac device rhythm management course or equivalent experience.

• 2+ years of recent implanted cardiac device management experience with knowledge of all manufacturer programmers.

• 3+ years cardiology experience, cardiac electrophysicology preferred.

• Experience with interrogating and interpreting device diagnostics for all four major manufacturers (Medtronic, Abbott/St. Jude, Boston Scientific, Biotronik).

• Cardiac rhythm management industry training and experience preferred.

• Must have at least one industry certification - Certified Rhythm Analysis Technician (CRAT), Certified Cardiographic Technician (CCT), Registered Cardiac Electrophysiology Specialist (RCES), International Board of Heart Rhythm Examiners (IBHRE) Certifications (CCDS, CEPS, CDRMS) also preferred.

• Proficiency with collaboration applications and software (Microsoft Office Suite, Teams).

• Minimum Device Specifications: Device must have a stable high-speed WiFi connection, at least 8GB RAM, a minimum 2GHz processor, and the latest version of Windows or macOS.

Benefits

• Employment: This is a contracted 1099 position without an end date

• Fully Remote: You’ll need access to a quiet working environment, high speed internet and your own computer equipped with sound/voice functionality

• Hours: Minimum of 8 hours per week (averaged across the month), set at least 8 weeks in advance

Your mission: make sure every HelloFresh Group brand benefits from the best referral journeys we build. This role goes beyond executing campaigns. You will work closely with CRM Operations, Product, Analytics, Pricing & Discounting and Creative - and you will lead the way in applying AI-driven solutions to make the referral CRM pipeline faster, smarter, and more scalable.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Greenlight is a family technology company on a mission to help families raise financially smart kids and navigate life together. Its suite of products - including the Greenlight app, debit card, Safe Family GPS trackers, and Family Hub - brings together financial tools, safety features, and everyday family management in one connected experience. Designed for busy families who want convenience without compromise, Greenlight continues to innovate alongside the evolving needs of modern life. Today, more than 6.5 million family members trust Greenlight to stay in sync.
At Greenlight, we're here to make the day-to-day easier and futures brighter, so families can spend less time managing life, and more time living it. That's why we get out of bed every morning.

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer with a passion for creating great products for great people (in our case the modern family). In this role, you will partner closely with both our IDC office (Bangalore) and the US based design team members contributing to UX/UI direction helping ensure quality and consistency for our product & services. Working alongside partners from Product Management, Engineering, Brand, Marketing, and other core teams, you will help ensure that Greenlight delivers truly lovable and memorable experiences.

We are a collaborative, full-stack Design org with disciplines that span Product Design, Brand Design, Motion Design, Print Design, and Design Program Management. We are led by our VP of Design, Creative Director, and Product Design Director and work closely with our Product, Engineering, and Marketing partners. Our team is critical in helping ensure that Greenlight delivers truly lovable experiences with product and brand expressions that are aligned. 

Who we are:
It takes a talented team to aim for a mission like ours. We're looking for people who ask "is it bold enough?" People who bring their real selves to the table and push the people around them to do the same. We win by never hesitating to jump in, offer a hand, or share the credit, because we know we're stronger together than apart. And through all of it, the mission stays the thing we measure ourselves against: are we doing right by the families counting on us? title: Strategy and Operations Analyst, Customer Success
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to make an impact at an extraordinary scale.

About the team

The Customer Success (CS) team oversees the post-sales lifecycle for Stripe users, helping them realise the full value of their investment in Stripe. CSMs drive user success, increase retention and expansion, and support mutually beneficial renewals. Few teams have such a direct impact on Stripe’s growth.

The CS Strategy and Operations (S&O) team shapes how Customer Success operates at Stripe, providing strategic and operational partnership to CS leadership. The team runs and improves both the function’s day-to-day operating model, from leadership forums and territory and compensation design to the systems and cadences that enable execution, and its long-term direction.

In this analyst role, you will help the team scale by surfacing insights for leaders, automating processes, building dashboards, and driving run-the-business operations. You will translate CS priorities into actionable plans, lead cross-functional initiatives, and build the operating mechanisms that help teams make better decisions, execute consistently, and scale effectively.

What you’ll do

The near-term focus of this role is to strengthen the operational foundations of Stripe’s Customer Success business. You will work on projects spanning process design, business cadences, systems, reporting and territory management, helping the team operate effectively as it scales.

As an analyst, you will turn data into actionable insights, measure and forecast business performance, and build dashboards that enable better decision-making. You will also identify opportunities to improve how the team works and partner across functions to design and implement scalable solutions.

Responsibilities

• Partner cross-functionally to identify, analyse and resolve systems and operational challenges

• Investigate system performance, operational workflows and underlying process issues

• Measure and forecast business performance, surfacing insights and recommendations to CS leadership

• Develop and maintain dashboards and reports that meet key business and leadership requirements

• Manage CSM territories and support improvements to territory design and planning

• Design and improve business processes using data and operational insights

• Define, track and report on annual and quarterly objectives and key results (OKRs)

• Prepare clear, decision-focused materials for quarterly business reviews (QBRs) and other leadership forums

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 5-6 years of operations experience in a software solutions or technology company.

• 3+ years working with a GTM or Sales organization.

• Data Analytics (SQL, creating/running complex queries and building dashboards) 

• Business and operational SLA reporting.

• Communicate clearly, proactively, and concisely. 

• Self-starter and comfortable dealing with ambiguity.

Preferred qualifications

• Tableau or SFDC report development experience.

• Experience as a User and Report developer in SFDC

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me , Do the Right Thing , and Get Things Done . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced risk leader to lead the risk management function at OKX Türkiye. You will own the local enterprise risk management framework and provide independent oversight and challenge to ensure risks are identified, assessed, managed and reported within Board-approved risk appetite. Working with local management and OKX Group functions, you will oversee risks arising from local operations, intra-group services and external providers.

You will advise senior management, the Risk Committee and Board on the firm’s risk profile, emerging risks and remediation priorities. The role requires sound judgement, the confidence to challenge decisions, and a strong understanding of Turkish capital markets, operational resilience and financial services controls. Experience with crypto asset platforms and custody is highly desirable.

•
Lead enterprise risk assessments and Risk and Control Self-Assessments with business and Group teams; maintain the risk register and challenge control effectiveness and residual risk.

•
Develop and recommend risk appetite and limits for Board approval; maintain key risk indicators, monitor exposures and promptly escalate breaches and material concerns.

•
Present clear, decision-focused risk reports to senior management, the Risk Committee and Board, highlighting exposures, trends, incidents and overdue remediation.

•
Provide independent oversight of technology, cybersecurity, data and crypto asset custody risks, challenging control design and effectiveness with specialist Group and local teams.

•

•
Oversee intra-group outsourcing and third-party risk, including due diligence, service performance, concentration risk, contractual controls and exit arrangements.

•
Work with Finance and Group specialists to develop and oversee capital, liquidity, market, credit and counterparty risk controls proportionate to the local business, including stress testing.

•
Oversee operational resilience, business continuity and disaster recovery readiness; challenge critical service dependencies, recovery plans, testing and incident lessons learned.

•
Assess risks from new products, business changes and emerging crypto market developments; oversee incident and issue escalation and validate effective remediation.

•
Act as the senior risk contact for local management and relevant regulatory engagement, working with Compliance and Legal; coordinate audit and regulatory findings and ensure timely risk remediation.

title: GTM Engineer
description:

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement - built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

YOUR ROLE

We’re hiring a Go-to-Market Engineer, a hybrid of a GTM operator, hands-on builder, and automation architect. You’ll join the newly established Business Technology Team to build the AI and automation that power Zip’s pipeline generation and sales motion. Your goal is to make AI part of how every rep works, measured in pipeline and rep time, not demos.

You’ll play a critical role in how our GTM workflows, tools, and data connect to drive prospecting efficiency and scale across the Sales and BDR organizations. This role primarily focuses on the presales motion, from BDR through AE. You’ll design and build the technical foundation that makes our revenue team faster, smarter, and more effective - driving transformational AI productivity benefits, not just 5-10% improvements

This is a rare opportunity to help define a new discipline at Zip. You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy, working across Sales and Marketing Operations, Business Technology, Internal AI, and Sales Leadership to turn complex business challenges into automated solutions reps actually use. If you thrive at the intersection of go-to-market strategy, systems design, and hands-on execution, this is your role.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Build the GTM automation engine. Design scalable, high-velocity workflows that improve rep efficiency, reduce friction, and accelerate pipeline generation. The Financial Crime Compliance (FCC) team at Airwallex is a strategically vital function operating under a clear Three Lines of Defense model. As the independent second line, FCC owns the global AML/CTF program, sanctions framework, risk assessment methodology, and governance infrastructure across all global entities. You will establish the baseline core compliance standards while guiding regional adaptations, oversee definition of controls across the FCC control framework, strengthen executive risk reporting, oversee risk-informed product engineering, and defend the integrity of the platform before global regulators and institutional partners. You will work closely with the Chief Regulatory and Compliance Officer, Global Head of FCC and senior leaders across the business to turn complex compliance trends into clear action, and shape strategic priorities and initiatives while scaling a high-performing, multi-disciplinary global team.

This role is based in New York or London.
